cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
smi='C[Si](C)(C)c1ccc[cH-]1'
lig=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(lig,randomSeed=201)==0
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(lig,maxIters=600)
base=np.array(lig.GetConformer().GetPositions())
center=base[4:9].mean(axis=0)
# Equatorial ring radius vectors defined by Si-bound carbon, projected onto Cp plane
sub=base[4]-center
ring_v1=base[5]-base[4]
normal=np.cross(sub,ring_v1);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
sub-=normal*np.dot(sub,normal);sub/=np.linalg.norm(sub)
tang=np.cross(normal,sub)
local=np.array([np.dot(base-center,sub),np.dot(base-center,tang),np.dot(base-center,normal)]).T
angles=[125,245,5]
elements=['Y'];coords=[np.array([0.,0.,0.])]
for i,angle in enumerate(angles):
 theta=np.deg2rad(angle)
 axis=np.array([np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta),0.])
 tangent=np.array([-np.sin(theta),np.cos(theta),0.])
 # selected silicon angles in ligand plane, vary so spatially separate
 phi=[45,-50,95][i]*np.pi/180
 sub=np.cos(phi)*np.array([0.,0.,1.])+np.sin(phi)*tangent
 # rotate ligand oriented Si to sub; ring plane sub x tangent2
 tang2=np.cross(axis,sub)
 M=np.array([sub,tang2,axis]).T
 projected=local@M.T+2.55*axis
 for atom,xyz in zip(lig.GetAtoms(),projected):
  elements.append(atom.GetSymbol());coords.append(xyz)
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(elements)}\nY(II) tris(trimethylsilylcyclopentadienyl) anion, S=1/2\n')
 for el,p in zip(elements,coords):f.write(f'{el:<2} {p[0]: .8f} {p[1]: .8f} {p[2]: .8f}\n')
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
for i in range(3):
 for j in range(i+1,3):
  c1=np.array(coords[1+22*i:1+22*(i+1)])
  c2=np.array(coords[1+22*j:1+22*(j+1)])
  d=np.linalg.norm(c1[:,None,:]-c2[None,:,:],axis=2)
  print('interligand',i,j,round(d.min(),2))
print('atoms',len(elements),'ligand charge',Chem.GetFormalCharge(lig))
PY
python build.py
